name: Regularised Marching Tetrahedra (Simplified)
aliases: Iso-surface extraction using Radial Basis Functions
definition: An algorithm to create an iso-surface for an object represented using radial basis functions by iterating over a volume grid and extracting intersections within tetrahedral cells.
summary: Regularised Marching Tetrahedra (Simplified) extracts iso-surfaces from radial basis function volumes by omitting vertex clustering, lacking the mesh simplification of the full method.
